records.name: arinox_letter_of_credit
records.script:
# Letter of Credit (Before Save): presentation deadline, latest shipment, amount used. u = frappe.utils notes = [] doc.on_board_date = None doc.presentation_deadline = None if doc.get("shipment"): on_board = frappe.db.get_value("Shipment", doc.shipment, "apparel_on_board_date") if on_board: doc.on_board_date = on_board deadline = u.add_days(on_board, u.cint(doc.presentation_days) or 21) if doc.expiry_date and u.getdate(deadline) > u.getdate(doc.expiry_date): deadline = doc.expiry_date doc.presentation_deadline = deadline if doc.latest_shipment_date and u.getdate(on_board) > u.getdate(doc.latest_shipment_date): notes.append(f"Shipped on {on_board}, after the latest shipment date {doc.latest_shipment_date}.") drawn = 0 for r in frappe.get_all("Sales Invoice", {"apparel_letter_of_credit": doc.name, "docstatus": 1}, ["grand_total"]): drawn = drawn + u.flt(r.grand_total) doc.drawn_amount = drawn limit = u.flt(doc.amount) * (1 + u.flt(doc.tolerance_pct) / 100.0) doc.available_amount = max(0, limit - drawn) if drawn > limit + 0.005: notes.append(f"Invoiced {drawn} against a credit of {doc.amount} (+{doc.tolerance_pct} %).") if doc.status == "Open" and doc.expiry_date and u.getdate(doc.expiry_date) < u.getdate(u.nowdate()): doc.status = "Expired" notes.append("The credit has expired.") doc.check_note = "\n".join(notes) if notes: frappe.msgprint("
".join(notes), indicator="orange", title="Letter of Credit")

records.script:
# API: arinox_close_production(production_card, reason): Production Manager closes a production card. # Nothing may be left in draft, every challan must be returned or short-closed, and shipped must reach the lower tolerance. u = frappe.utils card_name = frappe.form_dict.get("production_card") reason = (frappe.form_dict.get("reason") or "").strip() roles = frappe.get_all("Has Role", {"parent": frappe.session.user, "parenttype": "User"}, pluck="role") if "Apparel Production Manager" not in roles and "System Manager" not in roles: frappe.throw("Only a Production Manager can close production.") card = frappe.get_doc("Production Card", card_name) if card.docstatus != 1 or card.status in ("Closed", "Superseded", "Cancelled"): frappe.throw(f"Production card {card_name} is {card.status}.") problems = [] for dt in ["Cut Plan", "Lay Report", "Recut Request", "Pilot Run", "Line Input", "Line QC Report", "Subcontract Challan", "Finishing Receipt", "Packing List", "Final Inspection", "Production Adjustment"]: n = frappe.db.count(dt, {"production_card": card_name, "docstatus": 0}) if n: problems.append(f"{n} draft {dt}") for r in frappe.get_all("Subcontract Challan", {"production_card": card_name, "docstatus": 1, "status": ["in", ["Open", "Partly Returned"]]}, ["name", "status"]): problems.append(f"challan {r.name} is {r.status}") shipped = 0 for r in frappe.get_all("Production Movement", {"production_card": card_name, "stage": "SHIPPED"}, ["qty"]): shipped = shipped + u.flt(r.qty) lower = 0 for l in card.lines: tol = 0 for i in frappe.get_all("Sales Order Item", {"parent": card.sales_order, "apparel_colour": l.colour, "apparel_size": l.size}, ["apparel_qty_tolerance_pct"]): tol = u.flt(i.apparel_qty_tolerance_pct) lower = lower + u.flt(l.order_qty) * (1 - tol / 100.0) if shipped + 0.5 < lower and not reason: problems.append(f"shipped {int(shipped)} is below the lower limit {int(lower)}; write the reason to close short") if problems: frappe.throw("
".join(problems), title="Production cannot be closed yet") frappe.db.set_value("Production Card", card_name, "status", "Closed") card.add_comment("Comment", f"Production closed. Shipped {int(shipped)} of {int(lower)} minimum. {reason}") frappe.flags.status = "Closed" # an API Server Script returns frappe.flags frappe.flags.shipped = shipped frappe.flags.lower_limit = lower

records.script:
# Production Adjustment, After Submit: write the signed quantity to the production ledger (never checked against the flow).
def run(doc):
    rows = [{"stage": doc.stage, "colour": doc.colour, "size": doc.size, "qty": frappe.utils.flt(doc.qty), "purpose": doc.purpose or "Bulk",
             "process": doc.subcontract_process, "source_row": doc.name}]
    run_script("arinox_engine", action="post", card=doc.production_card, rows=json.dumps(rows), source_doctype="Production Adjustment",
               source_name=doc.name, posting_date=str(doc.posting_date), check="0")


run(doc)

records.name: arinox_production_adjustment_cancel
records.script:
# Production Adjustment, After Cancel: remove what it wrote to the ledger.
run_script("arinox_engine", action="unpost", source_doctype="Production Adjustment", source_name=doc.name)
